items.title: Sun Wheel Medallion DXF Panel with Chain-Link Border Frame
items.description: A radiating sun-wheel medallion sits at the heart of the panel, surrounded by a grid of arched cells and a beaded chain-link border on all four sides. The layered composition gives a stained-glass, architectural feel ideal for gates and room dividers.
